listing.name: Tetris (TetrisGBRecomp)
listing.summary: A Tetris Game Boy port that the project believes supports all modes without fallback execution. Use the corrected v0.0.3 package: v0.0.2 rejected even correct ROMs. Supply your own World v1.0 ROM with CRC32 63F9407D; v1.1 is not equivalent. Native PC release and source routes are documented, but exact OS/CPU coverage, further original-file hashes and BIOS/firmware requirements are unconfirmed here. You and the project manage setup and updates; Portcove has not qualified a release package or confirmed setup or gameplay.
